statement: A venture kept as one set of plain, checked records, with a ranked docket of the decisions a person owes and agents that may only propose, so one founder can run what used to need a team.
alternatives: Separate tools (CRM, wiki, finance app, tracker) plus a chat assistant
Autonomous company builders such as Naive (usenaive.ai) and Polsia
Doing nothing: a notes file and the founder's memory
difference: People decide by default; every record has provenance and a gate; definitions are checked by a term engine and Lean. Competitors sell autonomy; Naive sells judgment kept on record. (Positioning is a proposal.)

evidence.summary: Polsia markets 'AI That Runs Your Company While You Sleep'; Naive (usenaive.ai) describes itself as 'an AI research lab building autonomous companies'.
No person outside the builder has used Naive in a recorded trial; the beta checkpoints in beta/capabilities.json exist but no feedback records were found.
